Class Character

java.lang.Object
entity.Entity
entity.character.Character
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObject
public class Character extends Entity
Represents the player-controlled character.

Each selectable hero (e.g. Sukuna, Gojo) is stored as a Character instance in GameManager.getAllCharacterList(). When a run starts, the selected hero is copied into the active character slot.

Movement

WASD input is read from InputManager each frame. The movement vector is normalised for diagonal movement, tested against solid tiles via CollisionChecker, and then applied as pixel displacement.

HP & i-frames

Damage is gated by iFrameTime — after being hit the character is temporarily invincible to prevent being damaged every frame by the same enemy. Passive regeneration heals 1 % of max HP per second.

Magnet radius

Accessories and items within magnetRadius pixels are attracted toward the character automatically.

      public Character(String name, int speed, double maxHP, int magnetRadius, Weapon weapon, javafx.scene.image.Image icon, javafx.scene.image.Image sprite)
      Creates a character with all stats specified explicitly.
      Parameters:

      magnetRadius - item-magnet radius in pixels

      icon - 100×100 character-select icon
      sprite - 96×96 in-game sprite

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(InputManager inputManager, double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Advances the character's state by one frame.

      Steps performed in order:

      1. Decrement timers (i-frames, heal interval).
      2. Apply passive HP regeneration (1 % max HP / second).
      3. Read WASD input and build the movement vector.
      4. Normalise the vector for diagonal movement.
      5. Check tile collisions (may zero out dx/dy).
      6. Apply displacement to world position.
      7. Recompute the axis-aligned hitbox.
      Parameters:
      inputManager - the keyboard state for this frame
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame

    • render

      public void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc)
      Draws the character sprite and HP bar at the fixed screen centre.

      The character is always rendered at the screen centre (960, 540); the camera follows the character by scrolling the world around it.

      Parameters:
      gc - the game canvas's GraphicsContext

    • receiveDamage

      public void receiveDamage(double amount)
      Applies damage to the character, subject to the i-frame cooldown.

      If the character is still in its invincibility window (i.e. iFrameTime > 0) or is already dead, the call is ignored. Otherwise HP is reduced and a 0.2-second i-frame window is granted.

      Parameters:
      amount - raw damage to subtract (positive value)

    • heal

      public void heal(double amount)
